value.rationale: The all-k coloring enumerator gives complete information beyond the known scalar minimum, and its full structural proof explains which color reuses survive locally identifying requirements. The matching-size sensitivity has two plateaus for n>=3 and a 4-to-3 one-edge completion reversal at n=2.
